issues.message: Static traffic routes (ROAD_NET.routes) are not mapped to road segments in this extraction; empty traffic_route_ids does not mean no traffic.
Avenue and cross-street sidewalks are conservative 6 m strips outside the carriageway (CONSERVATIVE_AABB); other roads carry no sidewalk footprint.

SCENE_BOX3 footprints are conservative world AABBs of visible meshes and instances (<=40 m); tree crowns inflate obstacles. Boxes whose centre lies within 2 m of a building footprint are category BUILDING with parent_id (facade parts), the rest are OTHER.
playable_bounds and map_ui_bounds were not extracted (null); all candidate regions lie inside the 3200 m ground mesh and the 4800 m physical ground.
